propositions: referencing_commits walks all code history and resolves each commit's rebar-ticket trailer, but when aliases are present, resolve_ticket_id performs a fresh full-store scan (os.listdir + JSON reads) for each distinct alias, causing O(distinct_aliases x store) complexity
On production scale (5300+ ticket dirs), this causes single close operations to hang at 70+ minutes with high CPU usage
The fix adds build_alias_index to perform a single tracker-root scan and build an in-memory {alias -> [dir names]} map, then threads this index into resolve_ticket_id calls
When alias_index is provided to resolve_ticket_id, alias resolution uses in-memory lookup instead of fresh scans, reducing the total number of tracker scans to one per referencing_commits call
Single-id callers of resolve_ticket_id are unaffected because alias_index is an optional parameter defaulting to per-call scanning
Correctness is preserved: all id forms (full, short, alias, Jira, prefix) resolve identically to previous behavior, including ambiguous aliases resolving to None
